data_models.name: Link
data_models.declared_text: Reads Link(id, url, title, created_at) -- owned by save-link. This feature owns no entity of its own and adds no column; the ordering it guarantees is over created_at.
data_models.note: Feature declares <notes><data-model>. Copied, not inferred. This feature owns no entity and introduces no new column; it reads the Link entity owned by save-link. The ordering it guarantees is over created_at.

api_endpoints.purpose: Return every saved link as a JSON array, newest first by created_at. No pagination.
api_endpoints.returns: 200 with JSON array (empty array when no links are stored); 500 when stored links cannot be read
api_endpoints.inferred_from: list-links <description> ('A GET endpoint returning every saved link as a JSON array, newest first by created_at. No pagination.') and <acceptance-criteria> criterion 1, which names the method and path verbatim as 'GET /links'; status codes from criteria 1 and 4

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall return 200 and a JSON array from GET /links, empty when no links are stored.
The system shall order listed links most recently created first.
The system shall include every stored link in the listing, reporting a null title rather than omitting an untitled link.
If the stored links cannot be read, then the system shall return 500 and shall not return an empty array, so that a failure to read is never reported as an empty shelf.
acceptance_criteria.note: Criterion 4 carries no derived-from attribute in the source feature file; recorded as absent, not resolved.
